title: The first three digits are not a participant the Banxico snapshot knows
notes: The catalogue is a dated snapshot and participants are added and merged continuously, so an unknown code is only ever allowed to ask a question. This case exists to keep that asymmetry honest: the finding must not read as an invalid account.
